mapper.sql: r.*, lb.batch_name left_batch_name, rb.batch_name right_batch_name, (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_type = 'QUANTITY') quantity_issue_count, (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_type = 'UNIT_PRICE') unit_price_issue_count, (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_type = 'MISSING') missing_issue_count, (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_type = 'DUPLICATE') duplicate_issue_count, (select coalesce(sum(i.difference_value), 0) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_type = 'TOTAL_PRICE' and i.difference_value > 0 and i.status in ('CONFIRMED','RECTIFIED')) reduction_amount
mapper.insert: insert into cost_review_task ( project_id, left_batch_id, right_batch_id, task_name, status, rule_version, config_snapshot_json, left_item_count, right_item_count, compare_count, issue_count, medium_count, high_count, critical_count, risk_amount, started_by, start_time, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values ( #{projectId}, #{leftBatchId}, #{rightBatchId}, #{taskName}, #{status}, #{ruleVersion}, #{configSnapshotJson}, #{leftItemCount}, #{rightItemCount}, #{compareCount}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{startedBy}, #{startTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, '0' )
mapper.update: update cost_review_task set status = 'SUCCESS', issue_count = #{issueCount}, medium_count = #{mediumCount}, high_count = #{highCount}, critical_count = #{criticalCount}, risk_amount = #{riskAmount}, finish_time = sysdate(), error_message = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and status = 'RUNNING'

update cost_review_task set status = 'FAILED', finish_time = sysdate(), error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and status = 'RUNNING'

update cost_review_task r set r.issue_count = (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0'), r.medium_count = (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_level = 'MEDIUM'), r.high_count = (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_level = 'HIGH'), r.critical_count = (select count(*) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.issue_level = 'CRITICAL'), r.risk_amount = (select coalesce(sum(i.risk_amount), 0) from cost_review_issue i where i.review_task_id = r.id and i.del_flag = '0'), r.update_by = #{updateBy}, r.update_time = sysdate() where r.id = #{id} and r.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from cost_review_task r left join cost_boq_batch lb on lb.id = r.left_batch_id left join cost_boq_batch rb on rb.id = r.right_batch_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.project_id = #{projectId} and r.status = #{status} and r.task_name like concat('%', #{taskName}, '%') order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
select from cost_review_task r left join cost_boq_batch lb on lb.id = r.left_batch_id left join cost_boq_batch rb on rb.id = r.right_batch_id where r.id = #{id} and r.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.update: update cost_review_task set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and (left_batch_id = #{boqBatchId} or right_batch_id = #{boqBatchId})
